parameters.help_en: The template name. Maximum length: 30 characters
parameters.help_zh: 模板名称，最大长度 30 个字符
parameters.name: template_name

parameters.help_en: The subject of the email template. This parameter is required only when the templatetype is email. Maximum length: 256 characters
parameters.help_zh: 邮件模板主题，仅当模板类型为邮件时必填，最大长度 256 个字符
parameters.name: template_subject

parameters.help_en: The nickname of the template or the alias of the sender. This parameter is required only when the templatetype is email. Maximum length: 30 characters
parameters.help_zh: 模板昵称/发信人别名，仅当模板类型为邮件时必填，最大长度 30 个字符
parameters.name: template_nick_name

parameters.help_en: The body content of the email. This parameter is required only when the templatetype is email. Maximum size: 1 MB
parameters.help_zh: 邮件正文内容，仅当模板类型为邮件时必填，最大 1 MB
parameters.name: template_text

parameters.help_en: The business type of the SMS template. This parameter is required only when the templatetype is SMS
parameters.help_zh: 短信模板业务类型，仅当模板类型为短信时必填
parameters.name: sms_type

parameters.help_en: The body content of the SMS template. This parameter is required only when the templatetype is SMS. Length: 2 to 400 characters
parameters.help_zh: 短信模板正文内容，仅当模板类型为短信时必填，长度 2~400 个字符
parameters.name: sms_content

parameters.help_en: The remarks or application description for the SMS template. This parameter is required only when the templatetype is SMS. Maximum length: 100 characters
parameters.help_zh: 短信模板备注/申请说明，仅当模板类型为短信时必填，最大长度 100 个字符
parameters.name: remark

parameters.help_en: The source channel through which the user connects. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 用户接入渠道来源，默认为 1
parameters.name: from_type
